diagram_previews.alt: The nine points (x, y) with x, y in {1, 2, 3}, coloured by the parities of their coordinates. Red dashed segments join the four corner points in all six ways, a blue dashed segment joins (1,2) and (3,2), and a green dashed segment joins (2,1) and (2,3); the centre (2,2) is black; the corners (1,1) and (3,3) are labelled.
